summary: Hinsdale County SAR found and recovered the body of a 58-year-old Dallas-area fisherman from swollen Henson Creek about 1.5 miles west of Lake City on County Road 20 after heavy rains compounded high spring runoff
location: Henson Creek, ~1.5 mi west of Lake City on CR 20
notes: run 966 Lake City Silver World chunk: victim Daniel Gene Nunn, 58, of the Dallas area; DATE APPROXIMATE — body recovered July 13, drowning likely July 12; archive page carries the full article lede ("Search & Rescue Locates Body of Drowned Henson Creek Fisherman"); DB holds zero other Hinsdale rows for 2017
